meta.title: Selfloop — self-closing loop engine
meta.description: Selfloop turns any measurable target plus tunable parameters into a self-closing loop. The bundle ships two read-only tools (selfloop_probe parses an adapter and shows its domain, selfloop_list_adapters lists adapters grouped by domain), the run-time harness (iter.ps1 and its seven companions), a bundled static server, three adapters for the first domain vfx-render, and the selfloop skill. The tools start no browser and open no port; run the harness as the README describes. The harness is Windows only (PowerShell + Edge, it refuses to start elsewhere), Node >= 22.19, and the first Playwright run downloads ~740 MB of Chromium (zero download with the system Edge).
